// Sync, Device and Graph: Those settings now live in the database and are edited under Instellingen in the kiosk itself; their defaults are on the records in Zuil.Core/Settings/KioskSettings.cs. Values left in a config file are read only once, by FirstRunSeeder, to carry an existing installation forward. What stays here is what cannot change without a restart anyway.

Http.// Url: Loopback only, and deliberately not editable from the GUI: binding this to the LAN would turn the default admin password into a network credential.

Admin.// Password: Change this. Set ZUIL_Admin__Password, or put it in /opt/zuil/config/.env, which scripts/installzuil.sh generates. Anyone who has read this repository knows the default.
